Learn how to create, modify, and automate Stock SIPs using the updated experience on Zerodha Kite web. In this video, we'll show you how to add stocks, ETFs, or bonds directly to a SIP, choose between quantity-based or amount-based investing, schedule daily, weekly, or monthly investments, and automate funding with UPI Autopay.
Over 2 crore Indians invest with Zerodha. Open a free demat account in minutes and invest in stocks, mutual funds, ETFs, and bonds at 0 brokerage. No hidden charges, no gimmicks. Plus, get free access to research tools like Tijori, Sensibull and more.
